name: Ripple: German Grammar
subtitle: German, one change at a time
promotionalText: Build German sentences one small change at a time. Practice A1–B1 grammar offline, see why words change, and hear the result.
description:
Build German sentences one small change at a time.

Start with a simple sentence. Change its subject, tense or meaning, then fix the words that change with it. Each short chain helps you see how German grammar works together.

PRACTICE GRAMMAR IN CONTEXT
Explore 240 chains covering 51 A1–B1 rules: verb endings, articles, cases, adjective endings, word order and subordinate clauses. English translations keep the meaning clear.

UNDERSTAND WHAT CHANGED
Choose forms, arrange words and check your sentence. Specific explanations show why an answer works. Guided help adapts as you gain confidence, and a reveal option keeps you moving. Every action has a tap-based path.

SEE YOUR PROGRESS
Build a sentence gallery, revisit a chain’s changes and track your rule strengths. A short daily set brings earlier rules back into practice. Listen to German sentences with on-device speech.

LEARN OFFLINE
Lessons and learning progress work on your device. No account is required. Sign in with Apple only if you want optional progress sync. Analytics and crash reporting are optional and off by default. Export or reset your local progress in Settings.

RIPPLE PRO
Practice three chains a day for free. Pro adds unlimited chains, focused rule practice and Peel mode, which takes sentences apart in reverse. Choose a monthly or yearly subscription, or a one-time lifetime purchase. Localized prices and any eligible introductory offer are shown before purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled in your Apple account settings. Restore Purchases is available in the app.
